meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在 NanoClaw 容器中安装固定版本(0.1.6)的 Firecrawl AnyDoc 命令行工具,并添加一个技能,让 agent 能直接在本地把 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等附件转换成 Markdown,不会上传到外部解析器。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 容器加上本地文档转 Markdown 功能,或提到 agent 要读取 Word、PPT、Excel 等附件且不传外部服务时。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上本地 office 文档转 Markdown 的能力
say.note: 会安装固定版 AnyDoc 并添加容器技能

say.text: 让我的 agent 能把附件的 PPTX 转成 Markdown
say.note: 会用新的本地转换流程处理附件

howto.what_en: It installs the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI (v0.1.6) and a container skill into NanoClaw, so agents can locally convert attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, etc. files to Markdown instead of uploading to a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add local document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw, or mention agents need to read attached Word, PPT, Excel files without uploading to a remote parser.

say_en.text: Add local office-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Installs pinned AnyDoc and the skill.

say_en.text: Make my agent turn attached PPTX files into Markdown.
say_en.note: Uses the new local conversion flow.
